Paisley Things

Ethical Retail & Rural Income

Overview

Paisley Things is the retail arm of The Darius Tobing Foundation, a curated collection of ethical, handcrafted home goods made by rural Indonesian artisans.

We believe that beautiful objects carry stories. The batik on a cushion cover, the warp and weft of a handwoven throw, the grain of a carved wooden bowl, each one represents hours of skill passed down through generations.

By purchasing Paisley Things products, customers don't just acquire something beautiful. They sustain a tradition, support a family, and keep a craft alive.

Objectives

  • Provide rural artisans with fair and stable income through ethical trade
  • Preserve traditional Indonesian craft techniques for future generations
  • Connect Indonesian craftspeople with conscious global consumers
  • Build sustainable livelihoods that keep villages economically vibrant

Activities

Artisan Partnerships

We work directly with weaving communities, batik makers, and woodcarvers to source one-of-a-kind ethical products.

Fair Trade Retail

Products are sold through our online store and selected retail partners at fair prices that reflect the true value of handcraft.

Skills Training

Workshops and training sessions help artisans improve quality, adopt sustainable practices, and manage their businesses.
